info.name: Track Record API: core workflows
info.description: Functional, validation and integration tests for the core workflows: authentication, releases, tracks, splits, co-writer notices, export, and the Chrome extension's API calls. Run top to bottom: later requests use ids saved by earlier ones.

item.name: 00 Health
item.description: Read-only. Safe to run against the deployed Netlify site: newman run ... --folder "00 Health"

exec: pm.test('Returns a token and the user', () => { pm.expect(j.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(j.user.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('email')); });

item.name: Register: terms not accepted is rejected

exec: pm.test('Returns a token', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.collectionVariables.set('token', j.token); });

item.name: Forgot password: does not reveal whether the account exists

exec: pm.test('Same success response for unknown email', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 202]));
pm.test('Release is a draft owned by the user', () => { pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('draft'); pm.expect(r.release_type).to.eql('single'); });
pm.test('Album artist defaults to the artist name', () => pm.expect(r.album_artist).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('artistName')));

item.name: Create release: missing title is rejected
Create release: invalid release type is rejected
Create release: invalid date is rejected
List releases: invalid status filter is rejected

exec: pm.test('Changes are saved', () => { const r = pm.response.json().release; pm.expect(r.title).to.eql('QA Release (edited)'); pm.expect(r.label_name).to.eql('QA Records'); });
pm.test('Track is numbered 1 and has no audio yet', () => { pm.expect(t.track_number).to.eql(1); pm.expect(t.audio).to.eql(null); });

item.name: Create track: missing title is rejected
Create track: duplicate ISRC on the same release is rejected
Splits that do not total 100% are rejected

exec: pm.test('Percentages sum to 100', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().collaborators.reduce((s, c) => s + Number(c.ownership_percent), 0)).to.eql(100));
pm.test('Returns status, canMarkReady and a list of checks', () => { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('draft'); pm.expect(j.canMarkReady).to.be.a('boolean'); pm.expect(j.checks).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: Mark ready: result agrees with the readiness check

exec: if (can) { pm.test('Ready release is accepted', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200)); }

pm.test('Export is JSON and mentions the release title', () => { const body = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(() => JSON.parse(body)).to.not.throw(); pm.expect(body).to.include('QA Release (edited)'); });
pm.test('Export mentions the track', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('QA Track One'));

item.name: Set UPC: invalid value is rejected
06 Co-writer notices
item.description: Needs a local server started with DEV_OUTBOX=true so the notice link can be read. Skip this folder against the deployed site.

exec: pm.test('One notice for the invited co-writer', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.include('sent'));
pm.test('Contains a pending notice', () => { const n = pm.response.json().notices; pm.expect(n).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; pm.collectionVariables.set('noticeId', n[0].id); });

item.name: [Local only] Read the notice token from the dev outbox
